title: 第1001章 踏上离州第999章 拔苗助长
slug: 我在玄幻世界召唤奇物
content_zh:
同时也大概明白了，祁州这批法相境为何会参与其中。
已经寿尽，宣布死亡的项楚歌为何会出现在这里。
看来他之前猜测的没错，尹晨枫对北原出手，血日剑主对海外仙门出手。
两者之间的关系，或者说铸剑山庄跟尹晨枫的关系，也不一般。
既能获得鬼宴内的金丹给其他人提升实力。
也能获得云霞，给项楚歌一个小小的法相境延长寿命，以此来驱使祁州法相。
看来祁州的天人，也都见识过云霞延寿的能力了。
不然也不能让自家的法相境参与其中。
以寿命为奖励，确实很难抵御这种诱惑。
说不定不止祁州。
其余几州的天人势力，或者法相境，都已经暗中见识过云霞延寿的效果了。
姬玄同思绪流转，若有所思。
要是事情真如他所猜测的这样。
那大周朝廷现在的处境，已经是十分严峻了。
江湖不能为他们所用，书院内的那些天骄更不用说，绝大部分都来自于江湖。
铸剑山庄目的不明，洞天福地将要回归。
无论怎么看，都到处都是不稳定因素。
姬玄同心中一沉，沉默了片刻。
随即继续朝着海外仙门所在赶去。
与此同时，另外一边。

周正忽然长舒一口气，额头也稍微冒出一些冷汗。
“怎么了？”
一旁的易天疑惑问道。
李言的目光也随之看了过来。
“没什么。”
周正摇了摇头，没有将自己的发现说出来。
暗中躲藏的那人实力高深莫测，必然是一名天人。
不知道他会不会去而复返，还是不要将这件事告诉易天他们的好。
免得他们露出破绽。
无论是血日剑主还是剑徒，都诞生不了心魔，他自然也发现不了两人。
所以他发现的那人肯定不是血日剑主跟剑徒。
而这种时候，突然有一名天人出现在暗中，并且现在正在前往海外仙门那边。
周正不得不怀疑此人是不是大周朝廷的人。
看来大周朝廷的行动，比他想象的还要快。
content_en:
At the same time, I also roughly understood why these Dharma Realms from Qizhou were involved.
Why did Xiang Chuge, who had already expired and announced his death, appear here?
It seems that his previous guess was correct. Yin Chenfeng took action against Beiyuan, and the Bloody Sun Sword Master took action against the Overseas Immortal Sect.
The relationship between the two, or the relationship between Zhujian Villa and Yin Chenfeng, is not ordinary.
Not only can you obtain the golden elixir in the Ghost Banquet to enhance the strength of others.
You can also obtain Yunxia, ​​giving Xiang Chuge a small Dharma Realm to extend his life, so as to drive Qizhou Dharma.
It seems that the gods in Qizhou have also seen Yunxia's ability to extend life.
Otherwise, you cannot let your own Dharma Realm participate in it.
With longevity as the reward, it’s really hard to resist the temptation.
Maybe it’s not just Qizhou.
The celestial and human forces in the other states, or the Dharma Realm, have all secretly seen the effect of Yunxia's longevity.
Ji Xuantong's thoughts were flowing, thoughtfully.
If things were as he guessed.
The current situation of the Zhou court was already very serious.
The world cannot be used by them, not to mention the geniuses in the academy, most of whom come from the world.
The purpose of Zhujian Villa is unknown, and the paradise of Cave Heaven is about to return.
No matter how you look at it, there are instability factors everywhere.
Ji Xuantong's heart sank and he was silent for a moment.
Then he continued to rush towards the location of the Overseas Immortal Sect.
At the same time, on the other side.
Zhou Zheng suddenly breathed a sigh of relief, and a little cold sweat broke out on his forehead.
"What's wrong?"
Yi Tian on the side asked doubtfully.
Li Yan also looked over.
"Nothing."
Zhou Zheng shook his head and did not reveal his findings.
The person hiding in secret has unfathomable strength and must be a heavenly being.
I don’t know if he will come back, so it’s better not to tell Yi Tian and the others about this.
Lest they reveal their flaws.
Neither the Blood Sun Sword Master nor the swordsman could give birth to inner demons, so naturally he couldn't find them either.
So the person he found was definitely not the Bloody Sun Sword Master and the swordsman.
At this time, a heavenly being suddenly appeared in the darkness, and was now heading to the overseas fairy gate.
Zhou Zheng had to wonder if this person was from the Zhou Dynasty.
It seemed that the Great Zhou court was moving faster than he imagined.
